Commentary.Commentary: That concludes the proceedings. Here is the itinerary for Sunday, 7th August. England Women will face New Zealand Women in the bronze medal game at 2.30 pm IST (9 am GMT), while India Women will cross swords against Australia Women in the final for the gold medal at 9.30 pm IST (4 pm GMT). Do join us in advance for the build-up. Cheers!

Earlier in the match, New Zealand Women wasted a good platform to maximize the end overs with the bat and managed only a below-par total on the board. They lost five wickets in the last five overs which stole the momentum from them. As mentioned before, their bowlers tried hard and Lea Tahuhu was exceptional in her spell, picking a 3-fer. Now, they will be back on the field to contest for the bronze medal against England Women.

Yet another hard-fought win for Australia Women and they continue to show great character to bounce back from a precarious situation. It was a bright start for them initially but then they lost two wickets in the Powerplay. Beth Mooney, dropped on 7, combined forces with Tahlia McGrath, who was dropped on 14, and together they stitched a 56-run stand, off 36 balls. That partnership took care of the required rate and despite losing a few quick wickets after that, the world champions crossed the line.

Not a convincing win for Australia Women but a win nonetheless to book a gold medal match against India Women. New Zealand Women tried hard but dropping so many catches haunted them, and they ended up being on the losing side. They are visibly disappointed. Had they been clinical on the field, the result could have gone their way.
AUSTRALIA ARE IN THE FINAL! Fullish and around off, Gardner forces it down to straightish mid on, slightly aerial and scampers to the other end. Australia Women win by 5 wickets!
Too full and around leg, Harris helps it to square leg for one. Score level.

Shout for a caught behind, the umpire shakes her head. Full in length, around leg and drifting down, Harris tries to flick but misses. There is some sound but it is perhaps from the ball brushing the pads.
Goes outside off, Ashleigh Gardner hits it but finds the fielder at short cover. Two dots to end the over.
Full toss on middle, Ashleigh Gardner flicks it. The fielder makes a good stop at short mid-wicket.
Fuller and on off, Grace Harris forces it towards long on for one more. 2 more needed from 8 balls.
A full toss outside off, Ashleigh Gardner drives it to deep cover for one.
EDGY FOUR! This will help Australia Women! Full in length and outside off, Ashleigh Gardner goes for a full-blooded drive but only manages an outside edge past short third man. One boundary away now!
Full toss and on middle, Grace Harris flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
A low full toss on leg, Grace Harris flicks it. The fielder makes a good stop at square leg, diving to her left. They collect one run. 9 needed more.
FOUR! Vital boundary to make things easy for Australia Women. Devine fails to land her yorker, it's a low full toss outside off and Harris slices it through extra cover for a boundary.
Fuller again, Grace Harris drives but finds the fielder at covers.
Full toss on off, Ashleigh Gardner lofts it. The ball goes in the air and lands just short of the fielder at long on. Single taken.
Bowls it wide outside off, Ashleigh Gardner looks to play at it but couldn't reach it. Wide called.
Grace Harris is in next.

OUT! Excellent running catch from Bates. Are we going to see a late twist in the match? Fuller delivery, on middle and slower in pace, Haynes steps back to make room and tries to hammer it through the line. Ends up mistiming it behind the bowler and Suzie Bates comes running in from long on to take an excellent diving catch. She is pumped up. 16 needed off 16 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Suzie Bates b Sophie Devine

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Excellent start to the over for Australia Women! 16 needed off 17 balls. A low full toss on middle, Haynes pumps it over wide mid on and finds the fence.
Flatter and outside off, played down to point.
STUMPING MISSED! Flighted and around off, Haynes walks down the track for a big shot but fails to connect. The keeper fails to collect it cleanly. The batters cross for a bye.
Flighted up around middle, Ashleigh Gardner drills it towards mid off for one.
Fuller and on middle, Ashleigh Gardner flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace.
A low full toss, Rachael Haynes plays it towards long on for one.
Tossed up on off, Ashleigh Gardner looks to play at it but gets an inside edge as the ball rolls towards backward square leg. They cross.
Amelia Kerr is back on. 26 needed off 24 balls.
On off and fuller in length, Rachael Haynes defends it solidly. 4-1-20-3, what a fabuolous effort from Lea Tahuhu.
Fuller and outside off, Ashleigh Gardner pushes it towards point and risks a single. A direct hit at the non-striker's end and she could have been a goner.
Bowls it outside leg, Ashleigh Gardner looks to play at it but misses. Wide called.
FOUR! What a shot! Full in length, around off, Gardner stays leg-side of this delivery and clobbers it through the gap between mid off and extra cover. 28 needed off 26 balls.
Outside off and on a length, Rachael Haynes looks to slap it but gets a bottom edge. The ball bounces towards fine leg. They collect one run.
Slightly short this time, Rachael Haynes cuts it to backward point.
Yorker and down the leg side, Ashleigh Gardner flicks it off her shoes towards fine leg for one.
Too full and outside off, Rachael Haynes eases it towards short third man. 34 needed off 30 balls!
FOUR! This has been absolutely smoked by Haynes. A delivery on the fuller side, around off, Rachael uses her feet and spanks it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
A low full toss on off, Ashleigh Gardner hits it towards long on for one more.
On a length and around off, Rachael Haynes slams it towards mid off for one.
Yorker and on middle, Ashleigh Gardner digs it towards mid-wicket for one more.
Bowls a fuller one on off, Rachael Haynes flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Hayley Jensen is also back into the attack. She has been expensive in this match, leaking 23 runs in her 2 overs so far.
Fuller and around off, Ashleigh Gardner defends it towards mid off. A wicket-maiden at this stage of the match. Tahuhu has given New Zealand a sniff. 42 needed off 6 overs.
Outside off and fuller in length, Ashleigh Gardner drives it but finds the fielder at covers.
Fuller one again, Ashleigh Gardner eases it towards the mid off fielder.
Goes outside off this time, Ashleigh Gardner looks to drive but misses.
Touch fuller on middle, Ashleigh Gardner defends it to mid off.
Ashleigh Gardner is in next.

OUT! Mooney holes out! The set batter is removed and New Zealand Women are delighted. Extra pace of Tahuhu has done it. Full and around off, Mooney tries for an inside-out shot but mistimes it aerially to deep cover. A simple catch for Hannah Rowe who makes no mistake this time. 42 needed off 41 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Hannah Rowe b Lea Tahuhu

Commentary.Commentary: Lea Tahuhu is back on. 2 wickets for 12 runs in her 2 overs so far.
Goes fuller again, this is played towards the left of mid on for one. 42 needed off 42 balls.
On off and fuller in length, Beth Mooney eases it towards the fielder at covers.
FOUR! Shot! Full in length and outside off, Beth Mooney advances down the track and drills it through extra cover for a boundary.
Shorter one on middle, Beth Mooney looks to play an upper-cut but misses.
Full toss around middle, Rachael Haynes pulls it towards square leg for one. Oh, it's a no ball. Free Hit on the way...
On a length and on off, Beth Mooney guides it towards covers and scampers through for a quick single.
Fuller one on off, Rachael Haynes flicks it towards mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Full again, outside off, pushed to point.
EDGY FOUR! Full and wide outside off, Beth tries to drive but it takes the outside edge and runs down to third man for a boundary.

Shout for an lbw, not given! New Zealand Women decide to review it. Flatter one, around middle and turning down, Rachael Haynes goes back to flick but misses. She is hit on the pads, they appeal and the batters cross. Sophie Devine decides to review. The replays show that there is an inside edge.
Tucks it off her pads to mid-wicket for a run.
Another sweep shot and the ball is sent to deep square leg for one.
Swept through square leg for a couple.
Fuller and around off, Haynes inside-edges it through square leg for a run.
Full and around off, pushed to covers.
Rachael Haynes walks in next.

OUT! RUN OUT! Tahlia McGrath is out of here. The stand has been broken and New Zealand Women have an opening. Hayley Jensen delivers it on a length and outside off, Beth Mooney drives it to the left of point and sets off for a run. Amelia Kerr dives to make the stop and has a shy at the striker's end. Izzy Gaze is quick to reach the stumps, collects it with one hand and breaks the stumps. They appeal and it's referred upstairs. The replays find McGrath short of the crease. 61 needed off 56 balls.
Appeal for a run out...
On a length and on off, Tahlia McGrath guides it towards point and rotates the strike.

FOUR! Put away again. Tahlia McGrath is running away with the show. Fuller in length, close to off, Tahlia shuffles across and flicks it with brilliant timing through square leg for a boundary. 62 needed off 58 balls.
FOUR! Poor delivery and put away. The 50-run stand comes up, off 34 balls. A full toss on the pads, Tahlia McGrath whips it to the square leg fence.
Hayley Jensen is back on. 70 needed off 60 balls.
Fuller one this time, Beth Mooney drives it towards deep extra covers for a brace.
Slightly shorter one, Tahlia McGrath punches it towards long on for a single.
Fuller one on off, Beth Mooney works it towards mid-wicket for one.
Bowls it on leg, Tahlia McGrath looks to flick it but the ball hits her pads and rolls towards short fine leg. They cross for a leg bye.
FOUR! Blazed away! Loopy and full, dropping around off, Tahlia McGrath shimmies down the track and fires it through covers for a boundary.
Fuller with a hint of turn, Tahlia McGrath looks to play at it but misses.
Bowls it outside leg, Tahlia McGrath looks to play at it but misses. Wide called.
Fuller and on off, Beth Mooney plays it through point for a brace.
Fuller one around off, Tahlia McGrath walks down the track but fails to get her shot away. It takes her pads and rolls on the leg side. They cross for a leg bye.
Fuller one, with a hint of turn, Tahlia McGrath plays it with soft hands towards covers.

FOUR! This is what Tahlia McGrath is capable of, hurting you! Tossed up, full and around middle, McGrath skips down the track and clobbers it over the bowler's head. The desperate dive from the long on fielder goes in vain.
Tossed up on middle, Tahlia McGrath works it towards mid-wicket for a brace.

DROPPED! Hannah Rowe has put down a sitter. Giving life to Tahlia McGrath in this form is criminal. Full and flighted, on middle, Tahlia McGrath steps back and tries to loft it over mid off but fails to get the elevation. Rowe has a simple catch to take inside the ring but she spills it.
Amelia Kerr is back on. Her first over went for 9 runs.
Flighted up, around middle, Beth Mooney nudges it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace..
Tossed up delivery, Tahlia McGrath flicks it towards long on and rotates the strike.
Fuller and on off, Beth Mooney knocks it towards long off for one more.
Fuller one, around off, Tahlia McGrath flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Outside off again, Beth Mooney drives it towards long off for a single.
Tossed up, outside off, Beth Mooney eases it towards the cover fielder.
Fran Jonas to bowl again. 0 for 6 in her 2 overs so far.

FOUR! Shot! Sophie Devine digs it in short, around middle and leg, Tahlia McGrath controls the bounce well despite taking her eyes off the ball and pulls it well to deep backward square leg for a boundary. 10 from the over, 50 comes up!
FOUR! Boom! Tahlia McGrath is showing her range again. Fuller and around off, she extends her arms and lofts it over mid off for a boundary.
A low full toss, Tahlia McGrath hits it towards covers where the fielder makes a diving stop to her right. Dot.
Fuller one this time, this is flicked towards mid-wicket for one.
Shorter one on off, Tahlia McGrath looks to pull it but misses. The ball hits her shoulder and rolls towards the off side. They cross for a leg bye.
Fuller one on middle, Tahlia McGrath eases it towards the mid on fielder.
Sophie Devine brings herself into the attack.

FOUR! Finds another boundary in the over. Short in length and outside off, Mooney rocks back and slaps it through cover-point. The fielder tries to chase it down but fails to pull it back. Powerplay done. Australia Women are 40 for 2.105 needed off 84 balls.
Full and on middle, driven to mid on.
FOUR! Not from the middle of the bat but it still races away! Fuller and around leg, Mooney walks down the track and drags it past mid on for a boundary.
Short and outside off, cut to point.
Googly, on the shorter side around off, Tahlia punches it from the back foot to sweeper cover for a single.
Slower through the air, full and around off, McGrath tries to drive but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Amelia Kerr comes into the attack.
Sliding down the leg side, it's clipped with superb timing through backward square leg. A superb stop near the fence by Hayley Jensen to save one run for her team.
A length ball around off, defended to mid off.
Tahlia McGrath is the new batter in.

OUT! CLATTERED! Lea Tahuhu decides to do it all by himself. A low full toss, straight and around middle at 107.7 kph, Lanning plays all over it and fails to make any connection. It deflects off her pads and rattles the stumps. Lea is pumped up and it's a body blow to Australia Women. 117 needed off 92 balls.
Short and outside off, Lanning flashes at it and misses.
SIX! High and handsome! Release shot from Meg Lanning. Fuller in length, around middle, Meg Lanning brings her bottom hand into play and launches it over mid-wicket.

DROPPED! Mooney survives now. Tahuhu has another dropped catch off her bowling. A length ball outside off, angling away, Mooney makes room and tries to crack it through the off side but gets a healthy outside edge. Izzy Gaze dives across to her left but fails to hang on to the catch. They cross.
Beaten! Slower through the air, full and outside off, Meg Lanning tries to play late but it spins away to beat the outside edge. What an over, just one run off it!
Bowls it short and on off, Meg cuts but finds the fielder at backward point.
Quicker and on middle, defended back.
Flatter and around off, holding up a bit off the pitch. Lanning checks her shot and pushes it aerially towards covers.
Short and around off, Meg punches off her back foot to cover-point.
Slip in place for Meg Lanning.
Short and on off, Mooney goes back and pushes it to covers for a single.
Fran Jonas comes back into the attack.
Beaten! A touch short and outside off, Lanning tries to cut from the back foot but misses. Meg is looking a bit rattled at the moment.
Full and around off, driven to mid off.
Short and on off, steered through backward point for a single.
Around off, played down to covers.

PUT DOWN! Short in length and wide outside off, Lanning slaps it off the back foot but fails to keep it down. The point fielder (Amelia Kerr) dives across to her left side, and attempts to catch it with one hand but fails to grab it. Meg is away with a lucky break.
Meg Lanning is the new batter.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Healy has been strangled down the leg side. A length ball, drifting down the leg side, Alyssa tries to flick but it takes a fine tickle off her bat and goes to the keeper. Izzy Gaze takes a low catch diving across and Healy is seen walking. The umpire though wants to check whether it has carried to the keeper and refers it upstairs. The soft signal is out. The replays find that it's a perfect catch and Healy can continue with her walk to the pavilion.
Commentary.Howout: c Izzy Gaze b Lea Tahuhu

Commentary.Commentary: Lea Tahuhu comes into the attack.
Again it's on the leg side, full in length, Healy flicks it to deep backward square leg and regains strike with a single. 13 from the over!
FOUR! Put away! You cannot bowl there to her. Fuller in length and around leg, Healy picks it off her pads and flicks it delightfully through square leg for a boundary.
Fullish and angling in around off, it's pushed down towards mid off. Dot.

FOUR! Pure timing! A touch short in length and outside off, Healy hangs on the back foot and steers it through backward point. It keeps on racing to the fence and beats the attempt from the third man fielder.
Fuller this time, landing around off, Healy drives but finds the cover fielder.
FOUR! That's a magnificent shot! A full toss outside off, swinging in the air, Healy just pushes it with great timing and pierces the gap at covers for a boundary.
Hayley Jensen to bowl from the other end.
FOUR! Lovely hands of Mooney. Full and floated, around middle, Beth goes down on one knee and nails her sweep shot behind square leg. Opens her account in style.
Play and a miss! Slower through the air, short and outside off, Mooney tries to play late but misses.
Loopy delivery, full and on middle, Mooney flicks it towards mid-wicket.
A dipping full ball on middle, Healy walks forward and heaves it off the inner edge through mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up on middle, Healy defends it back.
Fuller in length and around off, it's driven to mid off.
